description.value: Fritz's European Fry House is a Davie Street institution that has been serving Belgian-style fries and poutine since 1996, making it one of Vancouver's longest-running late-night spots. It is a pickup-only counter known for its signature gravy with real cheese curds and an extensive sauce wall with over 20 dipping options. Located in the heart of the West End, it offers a quick and filling refuel for cyclists passing through.
